events.title: A Glorious Mess
events.text: {person:child} has redecorated the living room with yoghurt, crayons and what you hope is water.

choices.label: Clean it up together, giggling
choices.outcome_text: It took twice as long and I laughed the whole way through.

choices.label: Tidy it yourself, fast
choices.outcome_text: Spotless in twenty minutes. Somehow it felt lonely.

choices.label: Leave it for now
choices.outcome_text: I left my toddler's mess untouched and stepped around it all evening.

events.title: Wide Awake at 3 AM
events.text: {person:child} has decided that 3 AM is the perfect hour for philosophy and shouting.

choices.label: Sing until they drift off
choices.outcome_text: Halfway through the second song, small arms finally went slack.

choices.label: Hold the bedtime line, however long it takes
choices.outcome_text: Three nights of resolve. The household runs on schedule again.

choices.label: Let them sleep in your bed
choices.outcome_text: A small foot in my ribs all night, and somehow worth it.

events.title: Park Afternoon
events.text: {person:child} is tugging your hand toward the park with singular determination.

choices.label: Park trip plus ice cream
choices.outcome_text: Sticky fingers, sandy shoes, a perfect afternoon.

choices.label: Park trip, no treats
choices.outcome_text: We went to the park with no treats, and the swings were enough, mostly.

choices.label: Not today
choices.outcome_text: The walk home was very quiet.

events.title: But Why?
events.text: Today {person:child} has asked why the sky is blue, why cats purr, and why you are you.

choices.label: Answer every single one
choices.outcome_text: I ran out of answers before they ran out of questions.

choices.label: Turn it into a game of guessing
choices.outcome_text: Half my answers were wrong, but the laughter was real.

choices.label: Point at something shiny
choices.outcome_text: The questions paused. I know they will return.
